The net joint moments match the same worn mass only within a few percent, from a lever-arm check against the force plates. Which mass should LocoHub's standard GT24 moment, power and force columns be per kg of?

options.label: Leave GT24 kinetics empty
options.consequence: Left out: all standard GT24 moments, powers and body-weight forces. Published per-kg values only under source names; nothing rescaled. Reversible.

options.label: Worn mass (person + exoskeleton)
options.consequence: Left out: nothing; every recording has an exact exoskeleton divisor. Standard columns equal the published per-kg values, assuming the net moments use the same worn mass, as the lever-arm check supports; forces in worn-system weights; values 6-12 % below body-mass values. Reversible.

options.label: Body mass (without exoskeleton)
options.consequence: Left out: BT18 and BT24 (146 recordings) until their swapped mass rows are resolved, plus second-day recordings of BT06, BT07 and BT13 in the first collection (106 of their 336 recordings; no body mass reported). Published values x 1.07-1.13, assuming the net moments use the same worn mass, as the lever-arm check supports; comparable with datasets without an exoskeleton; published values kept under source names. Reversible.

proposed_decision_wording.options_order: By the normalizing mass: none (withheld), heavier (worn), lighter (body).
proposed_decision_wording.why: LocoHub defines forces in body weights and moments per kg; D-GT23-C03-1 rescaled GT23 to each participant's own mass; the task acceptance forbids substituting exoskeleton model mass for body mass. The published worn-mass values stay available under source names, so option B remains recoverable. The x 1.07-1.13 factor rests on the net moments using the worn mass, which the lever-arm check supports within a few percent but does not prove. Cost: the 146 BT18/BT24 recordings until resolved and the 106 first-collection second-day recordings lose standard kinetics.
proposed_decision_wording.check: README subject-mass table: every "w/ exo" mass is 6.1-7.8 kg above its "w/o exo" mass.
proposed_decision_wording.cost_of_waiting: GT24 standard kinetic columns cannot be finalized; all other GT24 work is unaffected.
